scope: Deterministic in-process Ganache tests only; no remote chain or production wallet.

tests.name: artifact reproduces exactly, has eight constructor inputs and no configurable cap ABI
exact 500T constructor issuance and 1500T regression each mint once to one recipient before pausing
distinct issuer and minter can issue beyond the former cap after admin unpause, once only
uint256 headroom reserves concurrent issuance exactly and burns release numeric capacity
cancel and expiry release reserved headroom during pause without reusing issuance IDs
pause contains issuance, transfers and burns while only admin can resume
configuration rejects zero identities, role overlap and unsupported role grants
authorization validates recipient, amount, reference and bounded lifetime; expired mint stays reserved until cleanup
delayed administrator rotation preserves distinct roles and removes prior admin authority

notes: Ganache used its JavaScript fallback because the optional native uWS binary was unavailable.
